title: Nine Pounds of Shoulder
subtitle: 肉铺与肉贩 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 肉铺与肉贩（生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：肉铺与肉贩（生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：butcher　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 butcher 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 my mother was sent to pay ① a butcher she could not read, and she said the reading was the whole of the lesson. The ② butcher, meaning the man and not the shop, was nine pounds of shoulder and was trusted by whoever came last; a butcher, she said, is the only thing in a market that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ butcher in that market had the same apron, and the ④ butcher at the end, meaning the one the widow owed and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever paid properly. A butcher, my grandmother said, is nine parts custom and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the custom is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ butcher was the whole of the trade, meaning the craft itself and not the man. The ⑥ butcher, meaning the trade and not any of that, is the only thing in a street that everybody greets and nobody questions; a butcher, he said, is either someone you pay or the only word that means both a man and a trade. She said the trade is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ butcher had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the apron. The ⑧ butcher of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine pounds of shoulder and eleven years of paying; a butcher, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ butcher I remember is the one at the end, which was closed in 1974 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ butcher, my grandmother said in 1979, is the only thing that improves by being trusted; every butcher, she said, is a trade that has agreed to look like a man. She said the trade was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 屠夫；肉贩；肉铺
B. n. 肉贩（指那个人本身，与店铺相对）
C. 固定搭配：pay a butcher 付钱给肉贩
D. n. 肉贩（指市场里每一位）
E. n. 肉贩（指末尾那一位）
F. n. 屠宰行业；手艺（抽象：与那个人相对）
G. n. 那门手艺（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a butcher she could not read
The butcher, meaning the man and not the shop
butcher was the whole of the trade
the butcher had become a photograph in a report
The butcher of the whole thing
A butcher, my grandmother said in 1979

answers.why: pay a butcher 意为“付钱给肉贩”，1951 年母亲被派去向一位她读不懂的肉贩付钱。
butcher 意为“肉贩”，指那个人本身而不是店铺，赊了九磅前腿肉，由最后走的人信任着。
butcher 指市场里每一位肉贩，每一个人都系着同样的围裙。
butcher 指末尾那一位（寡妇欠钱的那一位），是唯一有人认真付清过的。
butcher 意为“屠宰行业、手艺”，与那个人相对，父亲说 butcher 就是那门手艺的全部。
butcher 为抽象用法，指那门手艺本身，是街上人人都打招呼、却没人质疑的东西。
butcher 意为“屠夫、肉贩”，到 1969 年这位 butcher 成了报告里的一张照片。
butcher 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九磅前腿肉和十一年的付账。
butcher 意为“肉铺、肉贩”，我记得的是末尾那一家，1974 年关门，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
butcher 为抽象总称，祖母说肉贩是唯一会因为被人信任而变好的东西。
